children: Mystic Finance has launched liquid staking for PLUME. Users stake PLUME and receive myPLUME, a tradable receipt that can be used as collateral for swaps and lending across the ecosystem while earning up to 4.5% APY. This is the first liquid staking option for PLUME.

The design addresses the usual tradeoff between staking and liquidity. Because myPLUME remains usable in DeFi, holders can pursue staking yield without locking their position, which may draw PLUME into staking that would otherwise sit idle. Adoption is still at an early stage, so actual usage of myPLUME as collateral across the ecosystem remains to be seen.
Liquid staking for Plume is live on
Stake Plume, receive myPLUME, and use it as collateral for swaps and lending across the ecosystem.

title: Plume: Liquid staking goes live on Mystic Finance with myPLUME receipt token - 17 Sep 2026
